name: mcp-server-gsc
summary: mcp-server-gsc is a free open source Node.js server by ahonn that reads Search Console through a Google service account.
signIn: A Google Cloud service account JSON key, with the service account email added to the Search Console property.
tools: The README documents 1 tool, search_analytics, under Available Tools.
free: Yes, open source under MIT per the README and package.json.
writeActions: Not stated. The README documents only the search_analytics tool.
dataStorage: Not stated. It runs locally through npx with a credentials file path.
licence: MIT (stated in README and package.json; GitHub does not detect a licence file)
setup: Install Node.js 18 or later, create or select a Google Cloud project, enable the Search Console API, create a service account and download its JSON key, add the service account email to Search Console, then edit the Claude Desktop JSON config with the key path.
pickIf: You want up to 25,000 rows in a single request.
You want to tune your own quick wins thresholds for position, impressions and CTR.
You need image, video, news or Discover search types.
